The Scottish Parliament Building [ a ] is the home of the Scottish Parliament at Holyrood in central Edinburgh . [ 3 ] Construction of the building commenced in June 1999 and the Members of the Scottish Parliament (MSPs) held their first debate in the new building on 7 September 2004. The formal opening by Queen Elizabeth II took place on 9 October 2004. [ 4 ] Enric Miralles , the controversial Spanish architect who designed the building, died before its completion. [ 5 ]
